rows.label: qst650511_msg0001
rows.name: Here we are - this is Masura Spring!

rows.label: qst650511_msg0002
rows.name:
A mysterious-looking place,
isn't it... It reminds
me of Nightglow Woods.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0003
rows.name:
Nightglow Woods, eh? Is that
where you're from, Elma?

rows.label: qst650511_msg0004
rows.name:
No, not remotely. The place I come
from is very different still.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0005
rows.name:
It's a region on Mira. The White
Whale, the ship of the humans I
stayed with, arrived there from Earth.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0006
rows.name:
Tora doesn't understand 'planet,'
mo. Is the White Whale a
whale-shaped Divine Beast ship, mo?

rows.label: qst650511_msg0007
rows.name:
It's quite different from a
Divine Beast ship. The name
comes from Earth's literature.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0008
rows.name: Anyway, Mira isn't my real home...

rows.label: qst650511_msg0009
rows.name:
But for my companions and me,
it's becoming a second home...

rows.label: qst650511_msg0010
rows.name:
Different worlds, but
people everywhere are
doing their best to live.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0011
rows.name:
It sure sounds like it. And
Nightglow Woods didn't exactly
welcome us with open arms.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0012
rows.name:
Its enormous plants and
native creatures could
sometimes be threats...

rows.label: qst650511_msg0013
rows.name:
But that's inevitable if we're
going to live as part of Mira too.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0014
rows.name: Hmm. I guess that's how it is.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0015
rows.name: Yeah, but I feel like I get it.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0016
rows.name:
It's not like we haven't had to kill
some living creatures, or run away
from some monsters from time to time.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0017
rows.name:
But that's what it
means to live in Alst.

rows.label: qst650511_msg0018
rows.name:
That's how people
coexist with the world...

rows.label: qst650511_msg0019
rows.name:
Now then, let us investigate
this land, our beloved neighbor.
